burden of proving an injury in fact that is traceable to and redressable by Secretary
Griffin. It's important to keep in mind that this is a pre-enforcement challenge, which
means that for purposes of standing, Hamburger Marys must submit actual evidence, both of
an intention to engage in conduct that is arguably prescribed by the Protection of

submitted in support of its preliminary injunction motion in this case was its verified complaint.
